# adds_gmsa (Resource)

Manages an Active Directory group managed service account (gMSA) by executing PowerShell on a remote Windows host.

The password is generated and rotated by the Key Distribution Service (KDS), not managed here, so the account can be created enabled. A KDS root key must already exist in the forest.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "adds_gmsa" "websvc" {
  name          = "websvc-gmsa"
  dns_host_name = "websvc.contoso.local"
  path          = "Managed Service Accounts"
  description   = "gMSA for the internal web service farm"

  # Hosts allowed to retrieve the managed password. Usually the computer accounts
  # of the servers running the service, or a group that contains them.
  principals_allowed_to_retrieve_managed_password = [
    adds_group.web_servers.sid,
  ]

  service_principal_names = [
    "HTTP/websvc.contoso.local",
    "HTTP/websvc",
  ]

  kerberos_encryption_type       = ["AES128", "AES256"]
  managed_password_interval_days = 30
  enabled                        = true
}

resource "adds_group" "web_servers" {
  name  = "Web Servers"
  path  = "Contoso/Groups"
  scope = "Global"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dns_host_name` (String) Fully qualified DNS host name the account authenticates as, for example `websvc.contoso.local`. Required for a gMSA.
- `name` (String) Account name (the `CN`). Changing this renames the account in place.
- `path` (String) Container holding the account. Accepts a slash-delimited path relative to the domain root (for example `Managed Service Accounts` or `Contoso/Service Accounts`), a relative distinguished name such as `CN=Managed Service Accounts`, or a full distinguished name. Slash segments are always OU names. Changing this moves the account.

### Optional

- `account_expiration_date` (String) Date the account expires, as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Omit for an account that never expires. AD stores this as a timestamp, so the value read back may shift by the local UTC offset.
- `account_not_delegated` (Boolean) Mark the account as sensitive and not able to be delegated.
- `compound_identity_supported` (Boolean) Advertise support for Kerberos armoring / compound identity (Dynamic Access Control).
- `description` (String) Description.
- `display_name` (String) Display name (`displayName`).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the account is enabled.
- `home_page` (String) Web page address (`wWWHomePage`).
- `kerberos_encryption_type` (Set of String) Kerberos encryption types the account supports. Any of `None`, `DES`, `RC4`, `AES128`, `AES256`. Omit to leave the Active Directory default in place.
- `managed_password_interval_days` (Number) How often, in days, the KDS rotates the managed password. Fixed at creation; changing it replaces the account. Defaults to 30.
- `principals_allowed_to_delegate_to_account` (Set of String) Principals permitted resource-based constrained delegation to this account (`msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity`). Each accepts a distinguished name, `objectGUID`, SID, `DOMAIN\name` or `sAMAccountName`. This set is authoritative. Resolved distinguished names are published as `principals_allowed_to_delegate_to_account_dns`.
- `principals_allowed_to_retrieve_managed_password` (Set of String) Principals allowed to retrieve the managed password, usually the computer accounts or a group of hosts that run the service. Each accepts a distinguished name, `objectGUID`, SID, `DOMAIN\name` or `sAMAccountName`. This set is authoritative: principals not listed are removed. Resolved distinguished names are published as `principals_allowed_to_retrieve_managed_password_dns`.
- `protected_from_accidental_deletion` (Boolean) Protect the account from accidental deletion. This is not a stored attribute: it adds Deny access control entries for `Everyone` on `Delete` and `DeleteTree`.
- `sam_account_name` (String) Pre-Windows 2000 logon name. Defaults to `name`. Active Directory appends a `$`, so a trailing `$` you supply is ignored and the remainder must be at most 19 characters. Both `my-gmsa` and `my-gmsa$` refer to the same account.
- `service_principal_names` (Set of String) Service principal names registered on the account, for example `HTTP/websvc.contoso.local`. This set is authoritative: names not listed are removed.
- `trusted_for_delegation` (Boolean) Trust the account for unconstrained Kerberos delegation.

### Read-Only

- `distinguished_name` (String) Distinguished name of the account. Changes when the account is renamed or moved.
- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier. Equals the account `objectGUID`, which is stable across renames and moves.
- `principals_allowed_to_delegate_to_account_dns` (Set of String) Resolved distinguished names of `principals_allowed_to_delegate_to_account`.
- `principals_allowed_to_retrieve_managed_password_dns` (Set of String) Resolved distinguished names of `principals_allowed_to_retrieve_managed_password`.
- `sid` (String) Security identifier of the account.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Group managed service accounts are imported by objectGUID, which is stable across renames and moves.
terraform import adds_gmsa.websvc "b3f2b9a0-1234-4a85-a7a3-9bcbb6a41d02"
```
